title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
abstract: arXiv:2610.37649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run

translated_title: 大语言模型能否通过自由探索发现隐藏的物理定律？
translated_abstract: 科学发现往往始于一个意想不到的观察，由此引出新的研究问题。在一个物理定律被改变的世界中，大语言模型（LLM）能否注意到意外行为——例如更重的物体下落得更慢——并在没有被告知该研究什么的情况下，通过实验发现其中的定律？为了评估这种能力，我们提出了LongChang，这是一个自动化框架，可以创建物理规律被改变的模拟世界，其中一个或多个定律与常规物理不同。被评估的LLM扮演探索者的角色，操纵物体并构建工具来探究自己提出的问题，而没有任何研究任务或关于这些定律的提示。独立的LLM智能体负责生成和审查场景、审查工具设计，并利用被改变的物理定律和探索记录来评估报告的正确性及其实验支持度。这些记录引导场景演化以进行进一步探索，使整个循环得以持续运行。
tldr: 该论文提出LongChang自动化框架，通过构建物理定律被改变的模拟世界，评估LLM能否在没有任务提示的情况下自主注意到异常物理现象，并通过自由实验和工具构建发现隐藏的物理定律。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics to evaluate whether LLMs can autonomously notice unexpected phenomena and discover hidden physical laws through free exploration, tool-building, and experimentation without any task guidance or hints.
